hook: A shifting-lens trick expands 3D printer build area 4.8-fold without losing micrometer detail.
summary: A method called SPIN moves an off-axis lens in a small orbit to stitch several projected images, enlarging a resin 3D printer's area from 60.4 to 290.5 square millimeters. The printer made lines as thin as 9.8 micrometers and trusses with 30-micrometer features. Results are demonstrations on test structures, not production runs.
title: Segmented projection image translation for large-area, high-resolution vat photopolymerization.
